overview.text: Tally - Create Beautiful Forms for Free | Unlimited Forms & Submissions

offerings.text: The simplest way to create beautiful, professional forms in seconds. Unlimited forms, unlimited submissions, forever free. Just start typing - no coding needed.

Easily create online forms using our wide range of free input blocks. Collect contact info, files, signatures, payments, and much more. Build everything from surveys to quizzes to lead generation forms.
Our smart features make it easy to turn your forms into a tailored experience for every respondent.

Your data privacy and security are our top priorities. We are GDPR compliant and treat your data with care and confidentiality. Tally is hosted in Europe, we don’t use cookie-tracking, and all form data is securely stored, and encrypted both in transit and at rest. Learn more about Tally & GDPR.
